original_metadata.name: LearningPlan
original_metadata.description: 对比目标职业能力模型与用户当前能力基线，识别并排序真实差距，组织成阶段化学习路径并输出 LearningPlan artifact。
preconditions: 上游已产出 CareerCompetencyModel 与 BaselineAssessment 产物
用户已提供每周可投入时间与期限（或明确表示无期限）
postconditions: 独立 JSON artifact 已写入工作区并通过 ReturnSkillResult 返回引用

compiled_metadata.summary: Bridges a CareerCompetencyModel and a BaselineAssessment into a prioritized, stage-based LearningPlan artifact.
trigger_examples: 基于我的能力模型和基线评估，制定一个分阶段学习计划。
Build a staged learning plan from the competency model and baseline assessment we just produced.
我每周能投入 10 小时，希望六个月内达到市场要求，帮我排一个学习路径。
negative_trigger_examples: Research what abilities this role requires from scratch.
Assess my current level for this role.
Recommend specific online courses for machine learning.
